$ notify send
send to ["email" "chat"] through smtp.example.com:587, every 15m0s, retries 3
code 404: page not found
code 500: server error
[exit 0]

$ notify -c notify.yml send
send to ["pager"] through localhost:25, every 5m0s, retries 1
[exit 0]

$ notify send --flag-debug
  OPTION       VALUE                                         SOURCE
  --config     "notify.yaml"                                 default
  --channels   ["email" "chat"]                              key send.channels of notify.yaml
  --code       map[404:"page not found" 500:"server error"]  key send.code of notify.yaml
  --retries    3                                             key send.retries of notify.yaml
  --smtp-host  "smtp.example.com"                            key send.smtp.host of notify.yaml
  --smtp-port  587                                           key send.smtp.port of notify.yaml
  --window     15m0s                                         key send.window of notify.yaml
send to ["email" "chat"] through smtp.example.com:587, every 15m0s, retries 3
code 404: page not found
code 500: server error
[exit 0]

$ notify -c broken.yaml send
notify: send: config file broken.yaml: yaml: decode: yaml: unmarshal errors:
  line 6: cannot unmarshal !!seq into map[string]interface {}
[exit 2]

$ notify send >/dev/full
notify: main: write the options: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
